critique.evidence: Frame pacing is generally stable: mobile/tablet average 16.67ms with 16.8ms worst overall, desktop has no long frames but averages 20.73ms and reaches 33.4ms. The measured interaction lacks convincing interpolation: desktop is already at its final opacity/3D transform by the mid frame, while tablet/mobile mid frames are also nearly identical to the end. Reduced motion still applies the same substantial 3D rotation/translation and opacity change, reports 1 active animation, and exposes transitions on 46 elements. This is not sufficient reduced-motion proof or polished motion evidence for an 8.
critique.fix: Under prefers-reduced-motion, remove the 3D transform and active animation, using an immediate state change or restrained opacity-only feedback. For standard motion, provide a clearly measured eased progression across multiple frames and keep frame times consistently near 16.7ms, especially on desktop.
